chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and Muhammad ibn Hasan narrated from Muhammad ibn Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abd al-Khalik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The killer of Husayn (peace be upon him) was a son of fornication, and the killer of Yahya ibn Zakariyya (peace be upon him) was a son of fornication.
ai.seo_question: Who was the killer of Imam Husayn and what was his lineage according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) identifies the killers of Imam Husayn (a.s.) and Yahya ibn Zakariyya (a.s.) as 'walad zina', a term in Shia exegesis often interpreted as signifying illegitimate lineage or spiritual deviation. This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the continuity of opposition to the Ahl al-Bayt across prophetic eras, linking the martyrdom of the Prophet's grandson to that of the Prophet's cousin. The designation highlights how external enemies, whether through bloodline or character, consistently sought to extinguish the light of divine guidance.
